definition: The versioned store of trained model artifacts with stage transitions (staging, production, archived), linking each deployed model to its lineage: data, code, evals, approvals.
details: The versioned store of trained model artifacts with stage transitions (staging, production, archived), linking each deployed model to its lineage: data, code, evals, approvals. The governance backbone auditors ask about.

explainer.lead: A versioned store of trained model artifacts with stage transitions between staging, production, and archived. It links each deployed model to its lineage: data, code, evaluations, and approvals, making it the governance backbone auditors ask about.

tiers.eli5: Like a library catalog that keeps every edition of a book and records which one is currently on the shelf.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers register each model version with its artifact and move it through staging to production, keeping lineage attached. A common pitfall is treating it as storage only and skipping the approvals and eval links that make it auditable.
tiers.paperLevel: A registry holds versioned artifacts with stage labels (staging, production, archived), each tied to lineage records covering data, code, evals, and approvals.

explainer.example: A retrained model is registered as version 12, evaluated in staging, approved, then promoted to production while version 11 is archived.
